subject: Mathematics
title: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round

questions.q: The longest chord of a circle is its ____.
questions.explanation: A diameter passes through the centre and is the longest chord.

questions.q: A perpendicular from the centre of a circle to a chord ____.
questions.explanation: This is a standard circle theorem.

questions.q: Equal chords of a circle are ____ from the centre.
questions.explanation: Equal chords are the same distance from the centre.

questions.q: What is the angle in a semicircle?
questions.explanation: The angle subtended by a diameter on the circle is a right angle.

questions.q: The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is ____ the angle at any point on the remaining circle.
questions.explanation: This is the central angle theorem.
